description: This file contains implementation code for managing and querying MIME type caches, including functions for loading cache data from files, reference counting, and various lookup methods for MIME types based on file names, patterns, and data.

classes.name: _XdgMimeCache
classes.description: Structure representing a MIME cache with reference counting, version info, size, and buffer data.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_cache_new_from_file
methods.description: Creates a new MIME cache object by loading and memory-mapping a cache file.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_cache_unref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a cache object and frees it if no longer used.
